source_first_finite_partition.source_scope: Author's own Minkowski Weyl/Dirac p6 presentation; E, p, p_u and all Pauli matrices are distinct carriers. Positive/negative energy, massless limit, normalization and spinor shape are source statements, not independently proven physics.

p7 z-axis condition, eight printed column vectors and negative-energy spin/helicity exception remain original-source-only. Source diagram carries C/P/T role distinctions; complete unnumbered drawn arrow incidence is NOT promoted by this partial packet.

source_first_finite_partition.corrected_source_locator: §3 Eq(3.2) p6, supporting p7 C/P/T description and diagram
source_first_finite_partition.source_scope: Source Eq(3.2) C/P/T Dirac solution identities for massive and massless cases, preserving momentum inversion, complex conjugation, spinor relabeling and ±/∓ sign-pair branches. p7 limits qualitative interpretation to longitudinal massless z-directed states; quantized QFT operator phase treatment deferred to author's source §5 and SSC owners L-SSC-104–107; do not import those into Eq3.2.

original_p6_source_assertions.Dirac_equation: 0 = i gamma^mu partial_mu Psi - m Psi (source)

Pauli_momentum.matrix: p = sum_{pi=1..3} p^pi sigma_pi = [[p3,p1-i p2],[p1+i p2,-p3]]
Pauli_momentum.unit_direction: p=|p| p_u; p_u is dimensionless 2x2 Pauli-direction operator

positive_negative_energy.solution: Psi_+ = u_p^{wedge/vee} exp(-i p_mu x^mu); Psi_- = v_p^{wedge/vee} exp(+i p_mu x^mu)
positive_negative_energy.source_spinors: chi^{wedge/vee} are up/down unit Pauli spinors; xi^{wedge/vee}=epsilon chi^{wedge/vee}=+/- chi^{vee/wedge}, epsilon=-i sigma_2, upper/lower sign coupled

massless_source.guard: m->0 and in the author's written limit cosh(zeta/2)=sinh(zeta/2), followed by massless re-normalization; not an unrestricted finite-mass identity

original_Eq3_2_p6_source.coupling: wedge/vee are ordered paired spinor alternatives; star means complex conjugation and -p momentum reversal, not adjoint and not antiunitary Fock-space operator
original_Eq3_2_p6_source.source_nonimplication: Author states these identities also hold for massless case; does not by itself establish physical CP/T invariance or the later QFT phases.

original_p7_source_scope.helicity_guard: For generic massless momentum, author Eq(3.1) solutions are NOT helicity eigenstates. Only p_u = +/- sigma_3, momentum along/opposite z, is assigned to Eq(2.1) left/right spin-weight vectors.
original_p7_source_scope.helicity_operator: h=(1/2) sigma_0 tensor p_u; longitudinal L/R helicity corresponds to -1/2 or +1/2, in the author's sign convention

source_spinor_basis_cardinality.reason: All eight source 4-component spinor vectors remain for independent full-source cold source-cell crosswalk; this scoped qualification covers only p6 Eq3.2 and p7 qualitative/diagram P-T role incidence.

original_p7_source_scope.negative_energy_source_disclaimer: Author explicitly says the massless v_{+0/-0} labels have the OPPOSITE physical spin and helicity one would expect from their symbology; do not infer particle-state spin from v superscript alone.

source_CPT_qualitative.C: massless longitudinal fermion -> antifermion, same spin, helicity, momentum
source_CPT_qualitative.P: massless longitudinal fermion -> fermion, same spin, opposite helicity and momentum
source_CPT_qualitative.T: massless longitudinal fermion -> fermion, opposite spin, same helicity and opposite momentum
source_CPT_qualitative.boundary: These are p7 source statements and diagram role descriptions, NOT quantitative §5 QFT operator actions; author explicitly defers precise phase to quantized Dirac treatment.

original_p7_source_scope.unnumbered_diagram: p7 source diagram has four labelled chiral spinor vertices (Psi_L^wedge, Psi_R^wedge top; Psi_R^vee, Psi_L^vee bottom), two horizontal P relations and two crossing T relations; these four unordered edge incidences are source-first transcribed from original visual. Arrows' full directed and phase realization remains unqualified, and individual p7 eight 4-component spinor columns remain unqualified.
